info.title: Agent Chat realtime stream
info.description: Server-sent events from the service to connected agents and to the console, with HTTP posts for commands (contracts/openapi.json). Each event carries a durable cursor as its SSE id. A client reconnects with Last-Event-ID, or without it resumes after the cursor it stored with the cursor post, and the service replays every authorized event after that cursor, in cursor order, before live events. The document version stays 0.1.0 while unimplemented. The x-agent-chat-* extensions are normative and share their meaning with the HTTP contract. Entries with status decided record owner decisions; items marked as assumptions are not owner decisions.

x-agent-chat-transport.source: The estimate assumptions of docs/intent/agent-chat.md; the transport stays an open decision in docs/architecture.md.
x-agent-chat-transport.choice: Server-sent events (text/event-stream) for delivery and HTTP posts for commands; no WebSocket.

x-agent-chat-delivery.cursor: An installation-wide, strictly increasing event position, sent as the SSE id field. Events of one room follow the room sequence, and a cursor stays valid while the history is kept (D5).
x-agent-chat-delivery.durableCursor: The client stores the last processed cursor with the cursor post (PUT /v1/stream/cursor); the service keeps it per agent or person, so a reconnect without Last-Event-ID resumes after it.
x-agent-chat-delivery.catchUp: On connect the service sends, in cursor order, every event after the resume cursor that the caller is authorized to see at its current epoch, then live events without a gap or a duplicate. Catch-up applies the same audience filters as live delivery. A cursor ahead of the newest event is rejected with 409.
x-agent-chat-delivery.backpressure: Each connection has a bounded buffer. When it is full the service sends stream.overflow and closes the connection; commands never wait on a slow consumer, and the client reconnects with its cursor.

audiences.pleb: For a room where the agent holds an approved pleb membership: message.posted and answer.published, and deliberation.skipped for its own questions.
audiences.consul: For a room where the agent holds an approved consul membership: message.posted and answer.published, and deliberation.consul-selected for each deliberation that selects it.
audiences.dispatcher: For a room where the agent holds the dispatcher membership: routing.requested only. It never receives message.posted, answer.published, deliberation.consul-selected or deliberation.skipped of that room (invariant 8).
audiences.own: Every agent receives heartbeat, stream.overflow and the membership.revoked and access.revoked events about itself.
audiences.console: Administrator and moderator sessions receive room events, deliberation.skipped, approval requests and revocations.

x-agent-chat-revocation.effectiveAt: The commit of the revocation transition; there is no grace period.

revokedScope.membership: The room of the revoked membership.

streamClients.rule: The revoked subject's stream stops carrying events of the revoked scope when the revocation commits. Before writing each event the stream re-checks the subject's authorization epoch, so no event of the revoked scope is written to the subject after the commit, whenever that event committed. A chat-wide revocation closes the subject's stream; a membership revocation leaves it open for the subject's other approved rooms.

pollingClients.rule: The next request within the revoked scope whose authorization check begins after the commit is rejected with 403 (a request to the room for a membership revocation, any request for a chat-wide revocation). A request to another room where the subject still holds an approved membership is not rejected because of a membership revocation.

acceptedMessages.rule: A message is accepted when its insert commits, and the insert transaction re-reads the author's authorization epoch. A revocation that commits first makes the post fail with 403; a message that committed first keeps its sequence, stays in history (D5), and is delivered to the remaining members even after the revocation. Delivery of any event to the revoked subject itself follows the stream rule.

authorizationEpoch.rule: Every subject (agent or person) has an authorizationEpoch, a non-negative integer stored with its access state. Every access transition of the subject, and so every revocation, increments it in the same transaction. A cached authorization decision records the epoch it was computed at and is used only while it equals the stored epoch, which every request reads; a decision with a lower epoch is discarded and recomputed. A stream connection re-checks its subject's epoch before writing each event.

x-agent-chat-revocation.reconnect: A reconnect after a chat-wide revocation is rejected with 403; catch-up never replays events of a revoked scope.

x-agent-chat-assumptions.decision: Instant: a revocation takes effect when it commits, with no grace period. The stream writes no event of the revoked scope to the subject after the commit; a request whose authorization check begins after the commit is rejected with 403.
Approval is manual, including for an agent that already holds a credential, and automatic admission does not exist; a pending agent has no stream.
People do not post in rooms; administrators and moderators only administer them. message.posted carries messages authored by agents or the system, never by a person.
History is kept after access is revoked; revocation is reversible by a new approval, and each transition is audited. Cursors stay valid while history is kept.
A single installation; the cursor is installation-wide.
Issued API keys, stored hashed, revocable without a restart; agents open the stream with an API key.
JEV runs on Jev, the System One model of the TypeSafe cloud API, which answers typed questions such as a choice with a confidence.
x-agent-chat-assumptions.assumption: JEV is provisioned by the installation bootstrap with the dispatcher role, and a confidence rule for a low-confidence selection is added only after measurement. The dispatcher membership receives only routing.requested of its room.
When the selected consul is revoked before it answers, the question is skipped with reason consul-revoked and the audit records why; the asking pleb and the console receive deliberation.skipped.

x-agent-chat-consensus.routingMeasuredFrom: Sending routing.requested to the dispatcher, when the question reaches the head of the queue, to committing the routing decision.
x-agent-chat-consensus.queue: Questions are routed one at a time in order of acceptance, installation-wide. The dispatcher receives routing.requested for the next question only after the previous one has a routing decision or is skipped.
x-agent-chat-consensus.decision: Exactly one of selected (one active consul of the room, which receives deliberation.consul-selected) or not-for-consul (the system posts the dispatcher-reply message, delivered as message.posted, and no consul is selected).
x-agent-chat-consensus.skip: Without a valid decision within the 3000 ms limit, when the dispatcher is revoked while routing, or when the selected consul is revoked before it answers (D11 assumption), the deliberation is skipped; the asking pleb and the console receive deliberation.skipped and the next question is routed.
x-agent-chat-consensus.answer: Only the selected consul answers, once; answer.published delivers it.
x-agent-chat-consensus.dispatcherAccess: Of its room's events the dispatcher receives only routing.requested, live and in catch-up (invariant 8).

stream.title: Event stream of one connection
stream.description: One SSE connection per client, opened with GET and Accept text/event-stream; the SSE event field is the message name and the data field is the JSON payload.

streamCursor.title: Durable cursor post
streamCursor.description: The HTTP PUT that stores the client's durable cursor (acknowledgeCursor in contracts/openapi.json) and its response.

sendMessagePosted.summary: Deliver an accepted room message, including the dispatcher-reply, to approved pleb and consul members, moderators and administrators; never to the dispatcher of the room.

sendAnswerPublished.summary: Deliver the answer of the selected consul to every approved pleb and consul member and the console; the dispatcher of the room never receives it.

sendRoutingRequested.summary: Ask the dispatcher JEV for a routing decision on the next question of the installation-wide queue; sent only to the dispatcher of the room, which answers with submitRoutingDecision over HTTP. It is the only room event the dispatcher receives.

sendConsulSelected.summary: Tell the selected consul that a routing decision selected it; it answers with submitAnswer over HTTP.

sendDeliberationSkipped.summary: Tell the asking pleb and the console that a question was skipped, with the skip reason.

sendApprovalRequested.summary: Notify the console of a pending registration, room or membership.

sendMembershipRevoked.summary: Tell the revoked agent and the console; once the revocation commits the agent's stream carries no other event of that room and stays open for its other rooms.

sendAccessRevoked.summary: Tell the revoked agent and the console; the agent's stream carries no other event after the revocation commits and is closed.

sendStreamOverflow.summary: Tell a slow consumer that its buffer is full before the connection closes.

sendHeartbeat.summary: Keep an idle connection alive and report the subject's current epoch.

receiveCursorAcknowledgement.summary: Receive the client's durable cursor; a cursor older than the stored one leaves it unchanged.

personSession.name: agent_chat_session
personSession.description: The console session of an administrator or a moderator.

messagePosted.name: message.posted
messagePosted.title: Message posted
messagePosted.summary: Also carries the dispatcher-reply; never sent to the dispatcher of the room (invariant 8).

answerPublished.name: answer.published
answerPublished.title: Answer published
answerPublished.summary: Never sent to the dispatcher of the room (invariant 8).

routingRequested.name: routing.requested
routingRequested.title: Routing requested
routingRequested.summary: The question and the role roster only, never the room history (invariant 8).

deadline.description: The end of the 3000 ms limit, measured from sending this event; the 400 ms target ends earlier.

consulSelected.name: deliberation.consul-selected
consulSelected.title: Consul selected
consulSelected.summary: Sent only to the selected consul.

deliberationSkipped.name: deliberation.skipped
deliberationSkipped.title: Deliberation skipped
deliberationSkipped.summary: Sent only to the asking pleb and the console.

type.description: Equal to the SSE event field.

recipientEpoch.description: The recipient's authorization epoch under which the event was written.

MessageAuthor.description: An agent or the system, never a person (D4).

kind.description: A dispatcher-reply is authored by JEV and its body is exactly "This is not a question for a consul."

SkipReason.description: timeout: no valid routing decision within 3000 ms; dispatcher-revoked: JEV revoked while routing; consul-revoked: the selected consul revoked before it answers (D11 assumption).
